sub_graphs.title: EIP-1014: CREATE2 Contract Deployment
sub_graphs.description: Models the CREATE2 opcode execution flow for deterministic contract deployment

nodes.label: CREATE2 Opcode Invoked
nodes.description: EVM has encountered CREATE2 opcode (0xf5) during execution

nodes.label: Pop Stack Arguments
nodes.description: Pop 4 stack arguments: endowment, memory_start, memory_length, salt

nodes.label: Arguments Loaded
nodes.description: All 4 stack arguments have been read into EVM state

nodes.label: Read Init Code from Memory
nodes.description: Read initialization code from memory at [memory_start, memory_start + memory_length)

nodes.label: Init Code Loaded
nodes.description: Initialization code bytes have been read from EVM memory

nodes.label: Compute and Deduct Hash Cost
nodes.description: Calculate GSHA3WORD * ceil(len(init_code) / 32) and deduct from gas

nodes.label: Hash Cost Deducted
nodes.description: Additional gas for hashing init code has been deducted

nodes.label: Compute Deterministic Address
nodes.description: Calculate keccak256(0xff ++ address ++ salt ++ keccak256(init_code))[12:]

nodes.label: Target Address Computed
nodes.description: Deterministic deployment address has been calculated

nodes.label: Check Address Collision
nodes.description: Verify target address has zero nonce and empty code (per EIP-684)

nodes.label: No Address Collision
nodes.description: Target address is available for deployment

nodes.label: Address Collision Detected
nodes.description: Target address already has nonzero nonce or nonempty code

nodes.label: Execute Init Code
nodes.description: Run initialization code with endowment transferred to new address

nodes.label: Contract Deployed
nodes.description: New contract exists at deterministic address with returned bytecode

nodes.label: Push Address to Stack
nodes.description: Push the new contract address onto the stack

nodes.label: CREATE2 Complete
nodes.description: CREATE2 execution finished, address on stack

nodes.label: CREATE2 Failed
nodes.description: CREATE2 failed, zero pushed to stack

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1014: CREATE2 Gas Accounting
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for CREATE2 operations

nodes.label: Gas Available for CREATE2
nodes.description: Current gas remaining before CREATE2 execution begins

nodes.label: Deduct CREATE Base Cost
nodes.description: Deduct standard CREATE gas cost (32000)

nodes.label: Base Cost Deducted
nodes.description: Base deployment cost has been charged

nodes.label: Calculate Init Code Hash Cost
nodes.description: Compute GSHA3WORD * ceil(len(init_code) / 32) where GSHA3WORD = 6

nodes.label: Deduct Hash Cost
nodes.description: Charge gas for hashing initialization code

nodes.label: Hash Cost Deducted
nodes.description: Gas for init code hashing has been charged

nodes.label: Deduct Memory Expansion Cost
nodes.description: Charge for memory expansion if init code requires more memory

nodes.label: Memory Cost Deducted
nodes.description: Memory expansion cost has been charged

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for CREATE2 operation

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1014: CREATE2 Address Collision Prevention
sub_graphs.description: Models the security mechanisms preventing address collision attacks

nodes.label: Computed Address to Validate
nodes.description: Deterministic address has been computed, needs collision check

nodes.label: Check Account Nonce
nodes.description: Query the nonce of the target address

nodes.label: Check Account Code
nodes.description: Query the code hash of the target address

nodes.label: Nonce is Zero
nodes.description: Target address has never sent a transaction

nodes.label: Nonce is Non-Zero
nodes.description: Target address has prior transaction history

nodes.label: Code is Empty
nodes.description: Target address has no deployed bytecode

nodes.label: Code Exists
nodes.description: Target address already has deployed bytecode

nodes.label: Address Safe for Deployment
nodes.description: Both nonce is zero and code is empty - address can be used

nodes.label: Address Collision Error
nodes.description: Address already in use - CREATE2 must fail

nodes.label: Throw Invalid Opcode Error
nodes.description: Abort execution as if invalid opcode was encountered

ambiguities.text: The behavior when CREATE2 is called with zero endowment but the target address has non-zero balance (from previous SELFDESTRUCT) is not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume CREATE2 proceeds if nonce is zero and code is empty, regardless of existing balance at the target address.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify whether the 0xff prefix is included before or after RLP encoding considerations.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 0xff is a raw single byte (not RLP encoded) concatenated directly with the other preimage components.

implicit_assumptions.description: The keccak256 hash function is collision-resistant, making it infeasible to find two different init codes that produce the same deployment address.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could deploy malicious contracts at addresses expected to contain legitimate code, enabling contract impersonation attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot predict or control the salt value chosen by legitimate deployers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If attackers can front-run CREATE2 deployments with known salts, they could deploy malicious contracts at expected addresses before the legitimate deployment.

implicit_assumptions.description: The EIP-684 collision check is always performed atomically before any state modification.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Race conditions in collision checking could allow deployment to addresses that should be blocked.
